notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27207392/12daeddbe8735f5c7dac27d2390282d49ff9e7c6.png[/img]

Are you a fan of WORLD END ECONOMiCA but you want more? Then look no further, the WORLD END ECONOMiCA - Official Guidebook is available now on Steam! Please note that the guidebook contains spoilers so we highly recommend completing the trilogy BEFORE checking out the guidebook. And because this is a DLC you will need to own thee base game, WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.01, to purchase and download.

notes.title: âge 20th Anniversary Sale
notes.notes:
This week marks game studio âge's 20th anniversary. What better way to celebrate than to have a sale? Starting today at 10:00 AM PST to Nov. 1, 10:00 AM PST, save 40% on any of the Muv-Luv titles on Steam. Don't miss out on this opportunity as we salute âge's 20 years of service in the gaming industry!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/802880/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/802890/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/889700/

But wait, that's not all. There will be a special live broadcast on Youtube for the anniversary. The stream will go live tonight at 2:00 AM PST (6:00 PM JST). We'll have more details very soon including the Youtube link for you to watch the broadcast!

notes.title: WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.03 HD now released!
notes.notes: WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.03 is finally available on Steam in HD. This update also means that it is now able to run on Windows, Mac and Linux OS.

notes.title: WORLD END ECONOMiCA Complete Soundtrack Update
notes.notes:
A recent update was pushed for the WORLD END ECONOMiCA Complete Soundtrack.

Changelog
・Files are now separated into separate disc folders
・Missing tracks on disc 1 and disc 3 were put back in

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

notes.title: WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.03 Available in Japanese
notes.notes:
In addition to it's release in English, WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.03 is now available in Japanese.

For those of you who have already purchased the game, simply right click the game in your library, select properties and change the language under the Languages tab and the game should auto-update accordingly.

notes.title: Translated TIPs added
notes.notes:
Just like what the headline says, we've added the translated tips that were missing from the first initial release.

We're now focused on getting WEE2 ported so other platforms can enjoy the story.
